summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, four helper methods, and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run; the expected values were checked by hand (binary correct gives 0, flipped gives 1; batch-coupling case gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, mean loss 1/3). Line 36 of dice.py is 128 columns but was already there before this change. No commits were made.
